description: Standard aesthetic and VHS presets catalog for Mistus AV Merger

presets.name: Clean VHS (SP Mode)
presets.description: Authentic 90s commercial SP tape with noticeable horizontal softening, subtle CRT scanlines, mild chroma shift, and vintage tape warmth.

presets.name: Worn Tape (LP Mode)
presets.description: Heavy LP mode magnetic tape wear with horizontal color bleed, distinct CRT scanlines, bottom head-switching glitch bar, and magnetic noise.

presets.name: Tracking Errors
presets.description: Severe VHS tracking misalignment: heavy chroma split, horizontal scanlines, large head-switching bar, white sync tears, and tape static.

presets.name: Chroma Bleed
presets.description: Heavy composite RCA analog cable bleeding: bold red/cyan color misregistration offset, CRT scanlines, and saturated color halos.

presets.name: Camcorder 90s
presets.description: Nostalgic 1990s handheld camcorder: warm incandescent color balance, vivid saturation, CRT interlace lines, and tape grain.

presets.name: Security Cam (CCTV)
presets.description: Authentic CCTV surveillance footage: high-contrast monochrome with subtle phosphor green tint, CRT scanlines, 12fps surveillance stutter, fisheye lens vignette, and chunky sensor noise.

presets.name: Heavy Degradation
presets.description: Total tape decay & analog generation loss: extreme horizontal blur, intense chroma displacement, thick scanlines, bottom tracking tear, and heavy static snow.
